# redfish_ami_sensor_threshold (Resource)

Thresholds of one IPMI sensor of an AMI MegaRAC BMC. Firmware updates and cold starts may restore factory thresholds.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Fan sensors store RPM in 400-RPM steps; "0" disables stall detection for FAN3.
resource "redfish_ami_sensor_threshold" "fan3" {
  redfish_server { redfish_alias = "bmc" }
  sensor             = "FAN3_1"
  lower_non_critical = "0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `sensor` (String) Sensor name, e.g. FAN3_1.

### Optional

- `lower_critical` (String) Threshold as a number or "NA". Unset means unmanaged. Fan sensors store RPM in 400-RPM steps; a value the BMC rounds away fails the apply.
- `lower_non_critical` (String) Threshold as a number or "NA". Unset means unmanaged. Fan sensors store RPM in 400-RPM steps; a value the BMC rounds away fails the apply.
- `lower_non_recoverable` (String) Threshold as a number or "NA". Unset means unmanaged. Fan sensors store RPM in 400-RPM steps; a value the BMC rounds away fails the apply.
- `redfish_server` (Block List) List of server BMCs and their respective user credentials (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--redfish_server))
- `upper_critical` (String) Threshold as a number or "NA". Unset means unmanaged. Fan sensors store RPM in 400-RPM steps; a value the BMC rounds away fails the apply.
- `upper_non_critical` (String) Threshold as a number or "NA". Unset means unmanaged. Fan sensors store RPM in 400-RPM steps; a value the BMC rounds away fails the apply.
- `upper_non_recoverable` (String) Threshold as a number or "NA". Unset means unmanaged. Fan sensors store RPM in 400-RPM steps; a value the BMC rounds away fails the apply.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

Optional:

- `endpoint` (String) Server BMC IP address or hostname
- `password` (String, Sensitive) User password for login

- `ssl_insecure` (Boolean) This field indicates whether the SSL/TLS certificate must be verified or not
- `user` (String) User name for login
